purpose: Add optional fixed-view shape diagnostics and independently supervised coverage metrics before choosing a novel-view training loss
flag: evaluate(..., enabled=False) is inert by default
input: Existing frozen-model native1600 render sequences, downsampled to400x225; no direct low-resolution resplatting
frames: all200, also report validation30 times separately
no_GT_policy: Return observed_coverage=null and full_object_completeness_score=null; never turn a model-generated view or morphologically filled mask into independent truth
future_training: Existing observed-alpha coverage loss is differentiable. Novel-view priors need separate validation; no automatic solidification, per-object connectedness, spatial-neighbor gluing, material law, or full training is introduced here.
